note: Черга жартів дня, перемішана. Бот бере їх по черзі; позиція — joke_queue_pos у used.json.

jokes.text: "When I told everyone I was gonna become a professional stand up comedian, they all laughed… Well, they’re not laughing now!"

My buddy got arrested on drug charges and because it was his first offense, he thought he would get off lightly, but it turned out his lawyer was one of the worst in the state and ended up botching his case, so instead of getting a short term, he ended up getting 40 years without parole!!
Man, that sentence was way too long.

Our computers went down at work today, so we had to do everything manually.
It took me 20 minutes to shuffle the cards for Solitaire.
When I see the names of lovers engraved on a tree, I don't find it cute or romantic. I find it weird how many people take knives with them on dates.

Patient says, "Doctor, I have pain in my eye whenever I drink tea."
Doctor says, "Take the spoon out of your mug."
Why do turkeys play percussion? They have drumsticks.
What’s more unbelievable than a talking dog? A spelling bee.

Boss: "How is it that you are always sick on weekdays?"
Me: "It’s my weekend immune system."

My therapist says I have a preoccupation with vengeance.
We’ll see about that.
A Roman legionnaire walks into a bar, holds up two fingers and says, “Five beers, please.”
When's the best time to call your dentist? Tooth-hurty.
What do you call a fibbing cat? A lion.
Did you know the first French fries weren't actually cooked in France? They were cooked in Greece.
Why didn’t the chef season his dish? He ran out of thyme.
Getting paid to sleep would be my dream job.
Why did the thief take a shower before robbing the bank? He wanted to make a clean getaway.

What do you call a cow in an earthquake?
A milkshake.
Where do burgers go dancing? At the meatball.
Did you hear about the cheese factory that exploded in France? Apparently, da brie is everywhere.

Two nuns are riding their bicycles around the backstreets of Rome. One nun looks over at the other and says, “You know, I’ve never come this way before.” The other nun replies, “Must be the cobblestones.”
What do you call someone who raises hens? A chicken tender.

Dad: "I was just listening to the radio on my way into town, apparently an actress just killed herself."
Mom: "Oh my! Who?!"
Dad: "Uh, I can't remember... I think her name was Reese something?"
Mom: "WITHERSPOON?!"
Dad: "No, it was with a knife..."
My boss calls me "The computer." Not because of my calculation skills but because I go to sleep when left unattended for 15 minutes.

What do you call a row of rabbits hopping away?
A receding hare line!
How do celebrities keep cool? They have many fans.
Why did the cowboy adopt a wiener dog? He wanted to get a long little doggie.
How do fish pay for groceries? With sand dollars.
What kind of bird works on a construction site? A crane.
Why did the cow go to Hollywood? To be in the moo-vies.
Why do sweaters tend to hang out together? They’re pretty close-knit.
What does a painter do when he gets cold? Puts on another coat.

What do you call an unlucky sheep with no head and no legs?
A cloud.
Did you hear about the man who cut off his left leg? He’s all right now.
Despite the high cost of living, it remains popular.

What is red and extremely bad for your teeth?
A flying brick.
Where do elephants store luggage? In their trunk.

Two hunters are in the woods when one of them collapses. His hunting buddy immediately calls 911. "My friend isn't breathing," he shouts into the phone. "What should I do?" "Relax," the operator tells him. "I can help. First, let's make sure he's dead." There's silence, and then a gunshot. The guy gets back on the phone and says, "OK, now what?"
Did you hear about the octopus that held up a bank? It was an armed robbery.

What do you call an owl that’s a magician?
Who-dini.
Why did the employee get fired from the keyboard factory? He wasn’t putting in enough shifts.
Why did the little strawberry cry? His mom was in a jam.
What do you call a teenager that refuses to grow up? Constantine.

"How did you find out that doctor was fake?"
"She had good handwriting."

Doctor: “You have high blood pressure and amnesia.”
Patient: “Well, at least I don’t have high blood pressure!”
When is a door not a door? When it’s ajar.
"If your coffee shop has one of those passive aggressive "no wifi, pretend it's the old days" signs, I'm going to smoke in there and pay 50 cents for coffee."
What kind of music do elves listen to? Wrap music.
Why did the boy do his homework on a plane? He wanted a higher education.

What is the leading cause of dry skin?
Towels.

What do you call two celebrities fighting?
Star Wars.
I’m great at multitasking. I can waste time, be unproductive, and procrastinate all at once.
Why do hamburgers go south for the winter? So they don’t freeze their buns.
Why did the man bring his watch to the bank? He wanted to save time.
The man who survived both mustard gas and pepper spray is a seasoned veteran now.
The problem isn’t that obesity runs in your family. It’s that no one runs in your family.

What do you call a painting of a cat?
A paw-trait.

What gets wetter the more it dries?
A towel.
Turns out a major new study recently found that humans eat more bananas than monkeys. It’s true. I can’t remember the last time I ate a monkey.
I can’t deny that I made a lot of mistakes when I was younger. I’m older now, so I can make different, yet more severe mistakes.
What do you call someone with no body and no nose? Nobody knows.
People say that I’m creative and I couldn’t agree more because I create most of my own problems.

What do you call two monkeys that share an Amazon account?
Prime mates.

What do you call a doctor who fixes websites?
A URL-ologist.
What do you call a moose with no name? Anonymoose.
I was shocked when I found out my toaster wasn’t waterproof.
What does a librarian use to go fishing? A bookworm.

Why should you never eat a clock?
It’s too time-consuming.
Did you hear about the two rowboats that got into an argument? It was an oar-deal.

Four men are in the hospital waiting room because their wives are having babies. A nurse goes up to the first guy and says, "Congratulations! You're the father of twins."
"That's odd," answers the man. "I work for the Minnesota Twins!"
A nurse says to the second guy, "Congratulations! You're the father of triplets!"
"That's weird," answers the second man. "I work for the 3M company!"
A nurse tells the third man, "Congratulations! You're the father of quadruplets!"
"That's strange," he answers. "I work for the Four Seasons hotel!"
The last man is groaning and banging his head against the wall. "What's wrong?", the others ask.
"I work for 7 Up!"
What do you call a can opener that doesn't work? A can't opener.
A flat earther’s only fear… is sphere itself.
5/4 of people admit that they’re bad with fractions.

A pirate goes to the doctor and says, "I have moles on me back aaarrrghh."
The doctor: "It's ok, they're benign."
Pirate: "Count again, I think there be ten!"
The rotation of Earth really makes my day.
I have a few jokes about unemployed people, but none of them work.
I hate double standards. Burn a body at a crematorium, you're "being a respectful friend." Do it at home and you're "destroying evidence."
Have you ever had a bad sausage? It’s the wurst.
You’ll never be as lazy as whoever named the fireplace.
What did the calculator say to the pencil? You can count on me.
The problem with kleptomaniacs is that they always take things literally.
What do you call a fly with a sore throat? A hoarse fly.
Why couldn’t the toilet paper cross the road? It got stuck in a crack.

What do you call a policeman in bed?
An undercover cop.
Someone has stolen my Microsoft Office, and they are going to pay for it… you have my Word.
Why should you never use a dull pencil? Because it’s pointless.
What do you call recently-married spiders? Newly-webs.
How did the barber win the race? He knew a shortcut.
Did you hear about the ice cream truck accident? It crashed on a rocky road.
If I owned a DeLorean… I’d probably only drive it from time to time.
My cat constantly looks at me like I asked her to give me a ride to the airport.
Why should you borrow money from pessimists? They never expect to get it back.

4 beer company CEOs walked into a bar…
The CEO of Budweiser ordered a Bud Light.
The CEO of Miller ordered a Miller Light.
The CEO of Coors ordered a Coors Light.
The CEO of Guinness ordered a Coke.
The first three asked the CEO of Guinness why he didn't order a Guinness, to which he replied:
"I figured if you 3 weren't ordering beer it would be rude for me to."
How do you get a mouse to smile? Say “cheese!”
My boss told me I intimidate my coworkers, so I just stared at him until he apologized.
Why did the spider go to school? He wanted to be a web designer.

An Orangutan is sitting in his enclosure in the zoo. In one hand he has the Holy Bible; in the other, Darwin’s On the Origin of Species. “I can’t figure it out” he thinks; “one says I’m my brother’s keeper, and the other says I’m my keeper’s brother!”
A blind man walked into a bar… And a table… And a chair…

Doctor: "Sorry sir, but your body has run out of magnesium."
Man: "OMg."
I wanted to take a bath, but decided to leave it where it is.
Sorry, demons! There’s no room inside me because I’m self-possessed.

What do you call boys who love mathematics?
Algebros.

What did one Frenchman say to the other Frenchman?
How on Earth would I know? I don’t speak French.
Did you hear about the woman who couldn't stop collecting magazines? She had issues.
Why did the coach go to the bank? To get his quarter back.
What did the tree say when spring finally arrived? What a re-leaf.

Why are frogs always so happy?
They eat whatever bugs them.
When is a car not a car? When it turns into a parking lot.

My wife gave me an envelope with, “Not to be opened until 2027” on it.
Inside was list of reasons why I cannot be trusted to follow simple instructions.
What do kids play when they have nothing else to do? Bored games.
What does your boss have in common with a slinky? Both of them are entertaining to watch fall down the stairs.

Roses are dead, violets are dead.
I am a bad gardener.
If I got 50 cents for every failed math exam, I’d have $6.30 now.
Why do golfers always bring two pairs of pants? In case they get a hole in one.
What did one eye say to the other? “Between us, something smells.”
Why are shopping centers boring? Because if you've seen one, you've seen the mall.

My boss told me that there’s no such thing as problems, only opportunities.
I said: “That’s great. Well, I have a serious drinking opportunity.”
What do you call a bear with no teeth? A gummy bear.

A taxi passenger tapped the driver on the shoulder to ask him a question.
The driver screamed, lost control of the car, nearly hit a bus, went up on the footpath, and stopped inches from a shop window.
For a second, everything was quiet in the cab. Then the driver said, "Look, mate, don't ever do that again. You scared the living daylights out of me!"
The passenger apologized and said, "I didn't realize that a little tap would scare you so much."
The driver replied, "Sorry, it's not really your fault. Today is my first day as a cab driver — I've been driving a funeral van for the last 25 years."
Why did the poodle buy a clock? It wanted to be a watch dog.
Why did the computer get glasses? To improve its website.

George Clooney, Leonardo DiCaprio, and Matthew McConaughey get together to make a movie.
Clooney says, “I’ll direct.”
DiCaprio says, “I’ll act.”
McConaughey says, “I’ll write, I’ll write, I’ll write.”

Teacher: "What is an island?"
Little Johnny: "A piece of land surrounded by water except on one side."
Teacher: "On one side?"
Little Johnny: "Yes, on top!"
Did you hear about the cat that ate a lemon? Now it’s a sour puss.
What did the beach say when the tide came in? Long time no sea.
Why did the football player hire a lawyer? He needed help with his defense.
Someone, please help me! I’m way too young to be this old already.

A young boy enters a barber shop and the barber whispers to his customer, "This is the dumbest kid in the world. Watch while I prove it to you."
The barber puts a dollar bill in one hand and two quarters in the other, then calls the boy over and asks, "Which do you want, son?" The boy takes the quarters and leaves.
"What did I tell you?" said the barber. "That kid never learns!"
Later, when the customer leaves, he sees the same young boy coming out of the ice cream parlor.
"Hey, son! May I ask you a question? Why did you take the quarters instead of the dollar bill?"
The boy licked his cone and replied:
"Because the day I take the dollar the game is over!"
What do you call a potato wearing glasses? A spec-tater.
What kind of sandals do frogs wear? Open-toad.
Do mood swings count as exercise?
Did you hear about the broken guitar for sale? It comes with no strings attached.
I wonder how many miles I've scrolled with my thumb.

What do you call a Spanish man who has lost his car?
Carlos.
Why did the baseball player get arrested? He stole third base.
Why did the Energizer Bunny go to jail? He was charged with battery.
Bacon and eggs walk into a restaurant. The host says, “Sorry, we don’t serve breakfast here.”
I’m quite smart and intelligent. Most of the time, I don’t even understand a single word of what I’m talking about.

The Boss always insisted that only Abdul should serve his coffee, but yesterday, this conversation happened.
Boss: "Abdul, for the last 8 years you have brought me coffee filled to the brim without spilling even a drop. How do you manage that over these stairs?"
Abdul: "Sir, just before I climb up the stairs, I take a big sip. As I get upstairs, I put it back."
Today is Abdul's farewell party.
Why did the nose feel sad? It was always getting picked on.
Two eggs went to a party. They had a shell of a time.
Why are pigs bad drivers? They hog the road.
What do you call a rude cow? Beef jerky.

Guy pulls up to a gas station, and the attendant notices there are 5 penguins in the back seat.
Attendant says, "You have 5 penguins in your back seat."
"I KNOW!" the guy says, "They jumped in at the light, and now I don't know what to do."
Attendant thinks for a second and says, "I'll tell you what I'd do - I'd take them to the zoo."
"That's a great idea!" says the driver.
A week later, same driver pulls in with the same 5 penguins, only now they're wearing sunglasses.
"What are you doing - I thought I told you to take those penguins to the zoo!" exclaims the attendant.
"We did go! We had a great time! Today we're going to the beach!"

A guy is in for a job interview, and the interviewer asks him “What would you consider to be your biggest weakness?” The guy replies “Honesty. I’m honest with everyone; I don’t know how to be anything other than completely honest with every single person I meet.” The interviewer says “I don’t really see how honesty could be considered a weakness? In fact, I think honesty is a great strength!” To which the guy replies “I don’t really give a s**t what you think.”

During the concert little Johnny sits in the front row waiting for the concert to begin.
A friend asks: "Johnny, how did you manage to get a ticket to the concert?"
Johnny replies: "I got a ticket from my sister."
The friend asks: "And where is your sister?"
Johnny says: "Back at home, looking for her ticket."

What do you call an acid with an attitude?
A mean-o-acid!
What did the duck say to the waiter when he brought the check? “Put it on my bill.”

A man sits at a bar and orders 10 beers and drinks them one after the other. He then orders nine beers and drinks them as well, and this goes on and on. So he orders seven beers and drinks them, six beers and drinks them, five beers and drinks them, and then finally four beers. After drinking these last four beers, he says to the bartender: 'I don’t understand this. The less beers I drink, the more drunk I get.'
Why shouldn’t you argue with a T-Rex? You’ll get jurass-kicked.

Little Johnny’s new sibling was crying and screaming for hours. He asked his parents where they got him from. They reply, “Oh, we got him straight from heaven.” Johnny said, “Jeez. I see why they kicked him out of there.”

What do you call the security guards outside the Samsung factory?
The guardians of the galaxy.
What did the fish say after swimming into a cement wall? “Dam.”

What is a Karen called in Europe?
An American.
What do pigs use to clean up? Hogwash.

A guy said to God, "God, is it true that to you a billion years is like a second?"
God said yes.
The guy said, "God, is it true that to you a billion dollars is like a penny?"
God said yes.
The guy said, "God, can I have a penny?"
God said, "Sure, just a second."

Why did the dinosaur cross the road?
Chickens hadn’t evolved yet.
How did the farmer fix his torn overalls? With a cabbage patch.
What's the best way to catch a fish? Ask someone to throw it to you.
I don’t mind coming to work, it’s the eight-hour wait to go home I can’t stand.
What’s a zebra? A couple sizes bigger than an A.
Why did the phone wear glasses? Because it lost all its contacts.

Little Johnny is back at school after the holidays. After a few days, his teacher calls up Little Johnny's dad to report that Johnny has been behaving badly at school. His dad says to the teacher "Hang on a minute, I had Johnny at home with me for 2 months and I never phoned you once when he misbehaved."

What do you call a French gentleman who is wearing flip-flops?
Philippe Philoppe.

At the park with my girls: "Dad, can we go play?"
Me: "Sure, just stay away from those trees over there."
Girls: "Umm... Ok, why?"
Me: "I don’t know... They look a little shady to me."

A man was driving down the road when a policeman stopped him. The officer looked in the back of the man’s truck and said, “Why are these penguins in your truck?”
The man replied, “These are my penguins. They belong to me.”
“You need to take them to the zoo,” the policeman said.
The next day, the officer saw the same guy driving down the road. He pulled him over again. He saw the penguins were still in the truck, but they were wearing sunglasses this time. “I thought I told you to take these penguins to the zoo!”, the officer said.
“I did,” the man replied. “And today I’m taking them to the beach."

What do you call malware on a Kindle?
A bookworm.
Do you wanna box for your leftovers? No, but I’ll wrestle you for them.
Did you hear about the fire at the shoe factory? Many soles were lost.
How much does it cost Santa to park his sleigh? Nothing, it’s on the house.
What do you call an anxious fly? A jitterbug.
Why do bananas wear sunscreen? Because they peel.

What’s the one thing in life you can actually always count on?
A calculator.
"Racism isn't born, folks, it's taught. I have a two-year-old son. You know what he hates? Naps. End of list." — Denis Leary
What do you call someone who can’t stick to a diet? A desserter.
Someone once asked me if I would shoot my boss for $50,000... I said yes, I would definitely do that, but it's going to take me a while to come up with $50,000.
Why did the cake cross the road? It saw a fork up ahead.

I told my friend ten jokes to make him laugh.
Sadly, no pun in ten did.
Why are most people tired on April 1? They've just finished a 31-day March.
What happens when doctors get frustrated? They lose their patients.
How do you make holy water? You boil the hell out of it.
I told my mom I'd call her later, but she said she prefers “Mom.”
Every day is Friday when you’re unemployed.
What’s brown and sticky? A stick.
Why did the girl bring a ladder on the bus? She wanted to go to high school.

The teacher asked the class to stand up if they ever feel stupid. Johnny groaned before standing. She asked, “So Johnny feels stupid occasionally?” To which he replied, “No, but it must be hard for you to stand alone.”
My favourite childhood memory is my parents paying for my holidays.
Once I read a book about glue. I couldn’t put it down.
I spent a lot of time, money, and effort childproofing my house… But the kids still get in.
Why can't leopards play hide-and-seek? Because they're always spotted.
What do you call a girl in the middle of a tennis court? Annette.
How do you fix a broken tomato? With tomato paste.
What kind of cereal do leprechauns eat? Lucky Charms.
How does Darth Vader like his bagels? On the dark side.
I told a joke during our video call today. It wasn’t even remotely funny.
Why did the pony ask for a glass of water? Because it was a little horse.
Why did the drum go to bed? It was beat.

"What do travelers like best about Switzerland?"
"I’m not sure, but the flag’s a big plus."

One day Max went to see Carl. Carl had a big swollen nose.
“Whoa, what happened, Carl?”, Max asked.
“I sniffed a brose,” Carl replied.
“What?”, Max said. “There’s no ‘b’ in rose!”
Carl replied, “There was in this one!”
What’s the best air to breathe if you want to be rich? Millionaire.
Did you hear about the king that went to the dentist? He needed to get a crown.
Most people are shocked when they find out how bad I am as an electrician.
What’s the best way to get the hospital after breaking your foot? Tow truck.

Teacher: “If you got ten dollars from ten people, what would you have?”
Johnny: “A new bike.”
You know, it was so cold in D.C. the other day, I saw a politician with his hands in his own pockets.
I don't tell dad jokes that often. But when I do, he laughs.
What did the horse say after he tripped? “I’ve fallen and I can’t giddy up.”
When I die, I want to die like my grandfather who died peacefully in his sleep. Not screaming like all the passengers in his car.
I'm at a really low point right now, but the good news is that the worst is still to come.
Why shouldn't you play poker in the jungle? Too many cheetahs.
Is there anything worse than when it’s raining cats and dogs? Yes, hailing taxis.
I bought some shoes from a drug dealer. I don't know what he laced them with, but I was tripping all day!
Why do dragons sleep during the day? Because they like to fight knights.
I haven’t talked to my wife in a week. I didn’t want to interrupt her.

A middle-aged woman had a heart attack and was sent to the hospital. While on the operating table, she came very close to death and had the opportunity to speak with God.
“Is my time up?” she asked him.
“No,” God answered, “you still have 40 years, 5 months, and 3 days to live.”
Upon recovery, the woman decided that if she had so much time left to live, she might as well make the most of it. So she had a facelift, a tummy tuck, and dyed her hair before leaving the hospital.
While crossing the street on the way out, she was hit by a car and immediately died.
When arriving in front of God, the woman asked, “I thought you said I had another 40 years?! Why didn’t you save me?”
“I didn’t recognize you,” God replied.
Maybe if we start telling people their brain is an app, they’ll want to use it.
After a lengthy call with a customer who had been having difficulties with a computer program, a support technician turned in his report: “The problem resides between the keyboard and the chair.”

The wife and I took a long, leisurely drive out to the country and pulled over to fill up our car's gas tank and tires... She was surprised to see that the station had a fee to fill the tires and asked me, "Why in the world do they charge for AIR?!"
I responded, "Inflation."
What did the Dalmatian say after dinner? That hit the spot.
I wanted to make a joke about time travel, but you guys didn’t like it.
Why'd the roofer go to the doctor? He had shingles.

“Google Earth is amazing. They’ve photographed every road in the world and put them on the computer. You just type it in and you go there. You sit in front of the computer and you think, ‘I can go anywhere in the world. Where shall I go?’ And we all come to the same conclusion: ‘My house.’” — Michael McIntyre
My elderly relatives liked to tease me at weddings, saying, “You’ll be next!” They soon stopped though, once I started doing the same to them at funerals.
Why does a chicken coop only have two doors? Because if it had four it would be a sedan.

Me: I’d like to travel.
My bank account: To work?
Don't you hate it when someone answers their own questions? I do.

Did you hear the story about the claustrophobic astronaut?
He just needed some space.
How can you tell if a pig is hot? It's bacon.
I just realized that my life can’t fall apart if I never had it together in the first place.
Did you hear the rumor about butter? Everyone is spreading it.

Little Johnny's teacher is doing her rounds at lunchtime when she sees little Johnny pulling faces at another child. She starts to talk sternly to Little Johnny and says "Johnny, when I was a young girl I was told that if I made ugly faces and the wind changed, my face would stay that way."
Little Johnny looks up to her and says "Well miss, you can't say that you weren't warned."
Did you hear about the bossy man at the bar? He ordered everyone around.
Some people eat snails. They must not like fast food.

My wife called out to me from the other room: “Do you ever get a shooting pain across your chest… like someone’s got a voodoo doll of you and they're stabbing it?”
I said “No?!”
She said: “…How about now?”

What do dentists call their x-rays?
Tooth pics!
I asked my boss if I can come to work a little late today. He said "Dream on." I think that was really nice of him.
We are all time travelers moving at the speed of exactly 60 minutes per hour.
A man walks into a library and asks the librarian for books about paranoia. She whispers, "They're right behind you!"

“According to most studies, people’s number one fear is public speaking. Number two is death. Death is number two. Does that sound right? This means to the average person, if you go to a funeral, you’re better off in the casket than doing the eulogy.” — Jerry Seinfeld

My nagging wife died suddenly on a trip to Jerusalem. Funeral director, "Sir, it would cost about $45,000 if we send her home back to the states or $500 if we bury her here in Jerusalem."
Me: "Ship her home."
Funeral director: "But sir, why don't you bury her here in the Holy Land and you can save money."
Me: "A long time ago a man was buried here and 3 days later he rose from the dead, I can't take that chance."
How do you stop a bull from charging? You cancel its credit card.

What do you call a South American woman who is always in a hurry?
An Urgent Tina.
I’m proud to say that I never make the same mistake twice. I commit my mistakes more than twice just to make sure.
Did you hear about the 12-inch dog? It was a foot long.
I'm very familiar with paranormal activity. I keep getting ghosted.

A time traveller goes back to ancient Rome and immediately starts looking for local clothing.
He finds a tailor's shop and says "Hey, could I have a toga please?"
"Sure, what size?" says the shopkeeper.
"I don't know. Let's try an L."
The shopkeeper hands him a toga, the time traveller tries it on, then he says "It's a bit tight. Could I try an XL, please?"
And the shopkeeper says "What's the point of asking for a smaller one?"

Probably only Brits will get this: I was having a meal in an Indian restaurant. I was just finishing up and thinking about getting the bill when this little old lady came up to my table. She said: “You are such a lovely boy, with beautiful manners. You are a credit to your mum and dad.” Then off she toddled.
I said to the waiter: “Excuse me, but who was that?”
He said: “Ah yes sir: that’s your complimentary nan…”
What did the janitor say when he jumped out of the closet? Supplies!

Teacher: “If you had one dollar and you asked your father for another, how many dollars would you have?”
Johnny: “One dollar.”
Teacher: “You don’t know your arithmetic.”
Johnny: “And you don’t know my father!”
I was digging in our garden when I found a chest full of gold coins. I was about to run straight home to tell my wife about it, but then I remembered why I was digging in our garden.
What do you call a herd of sheep falling down a hill? A lambslide.
What is a calendar’s favorite food? Dates.

Boss: "Why should we hire you as a reverse psychologist?"
Me: "You shouldn’t."
250 lbs here on Earth is 94.5 lbs on Mercury. No, I'm not fat. I’m just not on the right planet.
Geology rocks, but geography’s where it’s at.
I used to work at a fire hydrant company. I quit after I couldn't find parking.

The flight attendant on our trip was handing out plastic pilot wings to some kids. As I stepped forward, she jokingly offered me one, but I passed. Pointing to the Airborne wings on my Army uniform, I explained, "The last time someone gave me wings, I had to jump out of the airplane."
Why did the employee go to work on stilts? He wanted a raise.
I have more conversations with the voices in my head than I do with actual people.
The last thing I want to do is hurt you; but it’s still on the list.
What do cats eat for breakfast? Mice Krispies.
How much money does a skunk have? Just one scent.

As he got back to the car, the mechanic looks up at the polar bear and says 'it looks like you've blown a seal'. The polar bear looks embarrassed, wipes his mouth, and says 'No I haven't, it's just ice-cream’!
